عَازِفٌ : see عَزُوفٌ. ＝
-A2- Also Playing with, or upon, the musical instruments called مَعَازِف: and singing. (S, O, K.) ―
-b2- [And, applied to a jinnee, Uttering, or making, the sound termed عَزِيف: pl., masc. and fem., عَوَازِفُ.] A poet says, in relation to the sound of the jinn, “وَإِنِّى لَأَجْتَابُ الفَلَاةَ وَبَيْنَهَا
عَوَازِفُ جِنَّانٍ وَهَآمٌ صَوَاخِدُ
” [And verily I cross the waterless desert when amid it are nightly hummers of the jinn, and hooting owls]. (TA.) ―
-b3- See also عَزَّافٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
